items.name: Swamp Monsters and PLAY exhibitions open
items.description: Swamp Monsters by Vipoo Srivilasa is made for kids: choose a costume and make your own swamp monster mask. Both exhibitions run until 24 January 2027.

items.name: Family Tales
items.description: Stories, songs and rhymes for families. No booking needed.

items.name: Halloween in St Albans Town Centre
items.description: Arts and crafts, Halloween face painting, glitter tattoos and bubble and balloon creations. Come dressed up.

items.name: Halloween at Wyndham Harbour
items.description: Trick-or-treating, market stalls, live and family entertainment and a costume contest at 1:30pm.

items.name: 7th Annual Melton Diwali Celebration
items.description: A children's dance competition, henna, face painting, multicultural food stalls and free sweets.
items.organiser: Australian Integrated Fijian Association of Victoria (AIFAV)

items.name: Sunshine Halloween Kids Street Party
items.address: Hampshire Rd, from Bennett Place to The Precinct Arcade, Sunshine
items.description: Trick-or-treating, three lolly dens, face painting, a treat hunt and a kids' costume competition on stage at 3:30pm.

items.name: Halloween in Fosters Road
items.description: Halloween-themed crafts and face painting for children. Dress up in your favourite costume.

items.name: Halloween Movie in the Park: Hotel Transylvania
items.description: Free outdoor movie with popcorn and entertainment from 5pm. Bring a rug or chairs. May be cancelled in poor weather.

excluded.name: Halloween in Glengala, Sunshine (Fri 30 Oct)
excluded.reason: On Friday afternoon, before the weekend.
